claim_summary: AI-Meteorologist contributes a fixed in-context multi-agent workflow that serializes hourly weather forecasts with climatological and geographic context and produces explanatory reports, hazard interpretations, and aligned plots.

claim_evidence.quote: The system employs a modular agent-based LLM architecture designed for the automated generation of explainable
The pipeline begins with data acquisition for a selected location, retrieving forecast time series via the OpenWeather API.

modules.name: Meteorological interpretation and hazard bulletin
modules.scope_reason: TSK: the core output contract is a structured weather summary, causal explanation, confidence level and hazard or anomaly warnings; changing the task family changes that report objective.
rubric_path: R4:Memory and Context; Interface and Interaction; Planning and Orchestration

evidence.quote: The core analytical component generates a structured output containing four key fields: a natural language summary outlining expected weather evolution; a causal explanation grounded in meteorological reasoning; a self-assessed confidence level; and warnings
Across all test cases, the system consistently identified key meteorological phenomena through explainable diagnostic reasoning steps.

modules.name: Temporal forecast and climatology context integration
modules.scope_reason: GTS: ingestion depends on hourly temporal order, resolution, units and information availability; changing the task family would preserve the temporal acquisition and serialized context interface rather than a task objective.
rubric_path: R3_2_GTS:yes - temporal order, frequency and availability govern ingestion
R4:Memory and Context; Tools and Execution

evidence.quote: The pipeline begins with data acquisition for a selected location, retrieving forecast time series via the OpenWeather API. This includes more than ten meteorological parameters, including temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, and visibility at a resolution of one hour.
All collected data are serialized into a structured EXTERNAL INFO block and propagated downstream to the reasoning agent.

modules.name: Code-generated report illustrations
modules.scope_reason: GTS: the Illustrator generates matplotlib plots of hourly forecast series, which depends on temporal order and resolution of the series; it embeds no task objective, so a different task family would reuse it unchanged (R3_1_TSK fails the counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - plotting is not bound to a task output objective

evidence.quote: Illustrator Agent. Based on the selected parameters, this agent generates Python code using matplotlib to produce plots of forecast data such as temperature, wind, and precipitation, ensuring that visual representations align with the textual narrative.

task_performance.quote: Across all test cases, the system consistently identified key meteorological phenomena through explainable diagnostic reasoning steps.

changes: dimensions: Coordination and Scaling -> Planning and Orchestration
reconciliation.reason: The packet supports the existing task procedure, but its legacy dimension label must be updated and its climatology-grounded anomaly reasoning is an additional supported task/function.
Plot generation is time-series visualization of forecast data and not bound to a task objective, so GTS rather than TSK; the GH test fails because the code operates on temporal series.

notes: Added aimeteorologist2025:temporal-context-integration because the packet describes substantive multi-source temporal ingestion and EXTERNAL INFO serialization. The fixed pipeline has no feedback-driven action selection. It explicitly says the prompt is not generating a forecast; it interprets past or present observed or modeled weather data. Quantitative forecast and explanation evaluation, and explicit process or temporal-validity checks, are not reported.

items.reason: The Illustrator only plots forecast variables aligned with the narrative; nothing in it embeds a task family's output or verifier, so TSK fails the counterfactual, while it works on hourly time series so it is not plain GH.

items.item: temporal-context-integration GTS module and weather-report TSK module
items.reason: Hourly API ingestion with climatology serialized into EXTERNAL INFO is substantive; weather report embeds the summary/confidence/warning contract.

adjudication.summary: The plot-code move to TSK was rejected in favour of GTS because the plotting step carries no task objective. Other modules accepted.
